prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite identity atlas. Transform the supplied labeled photographic contact sheet into a SIX COLUMN by SIX ROW transparent PNG atlas of 34 illustrated CARTOON HEADS ONLY, matching the detailed expressive Sunday Arcade 3D cartoon sports-player style in the second reference. FIRST reference is authoritative for every person's facial identity and exact cell order; SECOND reference is style only, do not copy its players or uniforms. Keep the first 34 cells in exactly the input order; last two cells bottom-right entirely empty transparent. Each head centered in its equal square cell, generous 15% transparent margins. HEAD AND SHORT NECK ONLY, no shoulders, no jersey, no arms, no body. Complete natural silhouette of hair including long locks, face ears beard, small neck stump centered bottom, neutral focused expression looking slightly right (three-quarter view). Faces recognizable from the individual reference, each with accurate skin tone, hair texture, hairline, facial hair and proportions, no generic cloned faces. Headbands may remain when in reference. Soft dimensional highlights, bold clean game-ready silhouette, smooth painterly cartoon shading, crisp at small sizes. Heads consistently sized at 70% cell height; neck endpoint at 85% cell height. No helmets. No footballs. No captions, labels, numbers, text, watermarks, grid lines, boxes, background or shadows. Real transparent alpha outside each head, do not paint checkerboard. This head atlas attaches to a shared animated skeleton; focus on individually recognizable faces.
inputs: reference-00.jpg through reference-15.jpg. Sheet 00 style: public/assets/characters/roster-0.png. Subsequent sheets use heads-00.png as style reference.
mapping: queue.json records exact names, roster IDs, cells, sources, body measurements and lineup roles. Do not change heads based on team order; use stable player IDs.
